== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Cosmic [[Path]] is the most advanced spell within the discipline of [[navigational magic]]. It functions by requesting a route from the [[Aether]] to a known destination, manifesting as a glowing golden river or road that stretches through space. While it is highly specialized for the high-speed navigation of starships across different star systems, it can also be used to guide various magical effects or locate specific points such as dive points. The spell relies on the existence of a viable route; if a path becomes blocked or impassable, the spell may terminate or fail to connect. Users must maintain high levels of competence to ensure the path remains reliable, as it serves as a precise guide through the darkness of space and [[Subspace]].}}
